verdict.rationale: LanceDB Enterprise documents client authentication through API keys and OAuth 2.0 for remote tables. The API keys are described only as a long-lived shared secret, and nothing in the evidence shows scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent credential issuance. Plain authentication is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
